vv53:1.1: vadataṃ pavaro manujesu Sakyamunī bhagavā katakicco pāragato balaviriya-samaṅgī taṃ sugataṃ saraṇattham upehi. || ||
vv53:2.1: Rāgavirāgam anejam asokaṃ dhammam asaṅkhatam appaṭikūlaṃ madhuram imaṃ paguṇaṃ suvibhattaṃ dhammam imaṃ saraṇattham upehi. || ||
vv53:3.1: Yattha ca dinnamahapphalam āhu catusu sucīsu purisayugesu aṭṭha ca puggaladhammadasā te saṅgham imaṃ saraṇattham upehi. || ||
vv53:4.1: Na tathā tapati nabhasmiṃ suriyo cando ca na bhāsati na phusso yathātulam idaṃ mahappabhāsaṃ ko nu tvaṃ Tidivā mahiṃ upāgā. || ||
vv53:5.1: Chindati ca raṃsi pabhaṅkarassa sādhikavīsativojanāni ābhā rattim pi ca yathā divaṃ karoti parisuddhaṃ vimalaṃ subhaṃ vimānaṃ. || ||
vv53:6.1: Bahupadumavicitrapuṇḍarīkaṃ vokiṇṇaṃ kusumehi nekacittaṃ arajavirajahemajālacchannaṃ ākāse tapati yathā pi suriyo. || ||
vv53:7.1: Rattambarapītavāsasāhi agarupiyaṅgucandanussadāhi kañcanatanusannibhattacāhi paripūraṃ gaganaṃ va tārakāhi. || ||
vv53:8.1: Naranāriyo bahuk' ettha nekavaṇṇā kusumavibhūsitābharaṇ' ettha sumanā anilapamuñcitā pavanti surabhiṃ. tapanīyavitatā suvaṇṇacchādanā. || ||
vv53:9.1: Kissa saṃyamassa ayaṃ vipāko kenāsi kammaphalen' idhūpapanno yathā ca te adhigatam idaṃ vimānaṃ tad anupadaṃ avacāsi iṅgha puṭṭho ti. || ||
vv53:10.1: Yam idha pathe samecca māṇavena satthānusāsi anukampamāno tava ratanavarassa dhammaṃ sutvā karissāmī ti ca bravittha Chatto, || ||
vv53:11.1: Jinavarapavaraṃ upemi saraṇaṃ dhammañ cāpi tath' eva bhikkhusaṅghaṃ, no ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:12.1: Mā ca pāṇavadhaṃ vividhaṃ carassu asuciṃ na hi pāṇesu asaññataṃ avaṇṇayiṃsu sappaññāno ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:13.1: Mā ca parajanassa rakkhitam pi ādātabbam amaññittha adinnaṃ no ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:14.1: Mā ca parajanassa rakkhitāyo parabhariyā agamā anariyam etaṃ no ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:15.1: Mā ca vitathaṃ aññathā abhāṇi na hi musāvādaṃ avaṇṇayiṃsu sapaññā no ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:16.1: Yena ca purisassa apeti saññā taṃ majjaṃ parivajjayassu sabbaṃ no ti paṭhamaṃ avocāhaṃ bhante pacchā te vacanaṃ tath' ev' akāsiṃ. || ||
vv53:17.1: Svāhaṃ idha pañca sikkhā karitvā paṭipajjitvā tathāgatassa dhamme dvepatham agamāsiṃ coramajjhe te maṃ tattha vadhiṃsu bhogahetu. || ||
vv53:18.1: Ettakam idaṃ anussarāmi kusalaṃ tato paraṃ na me vijjati aññaṃ tena sucaritena kammunāhaṃ upapanno Tidivesu kāmakāmī. || ||
vv53:19.1: Passa khaṇamuhuttasaññamassa anudhammapaṭipattiyā vipākaṃ jalam iva yasasā samekkhamānā bahukā maṃ pihayanti hīnakāmā. || ||
vv53:20.1: Passa katipayāya desanāya sugatiñ c' amhi gato sukhañ ca patto ye ca te satataṃ suṇanti dhammaṃ maññe te amataṃ phusanti khemaṃ. || ||
vv53:21.1: Appakam pi kataṃ mahāvipākaṃ vipulaṃ hoti tathāgatassa dhamme passa katapuññatāya Chatto obhāseti paṭhaviṃ yathā pi suriyo. || ||
vv53:22.1: Kim idaṃ kusalaṃ ācarema icc eke hi samecca mantayanti te mayaṃ punar eva laddha mānusattaṃ paṭipannā viharemu sīlavanto. || ||
vv53:23.1: Bahukāro m' anukampako ca satthā iti me sati agamā divādivassa svāhaṃ upagato 'mhi saccanāmaṃ anukampassu puna pi suṇemu dhammaṃ. || ||
vv53:24.1: Ye 'dha pajahanti kāmarāgaṃ bhavarāgānusayañ ca pahāya mohaṃ na ca te puna upenti gabbhaseyyaṃ parinibbānagatā hi sītibhūtā ti. || ||
